text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate observed for /v1/infer (region-us-east) - 12m window, 18% error rate

mike_oncall: I see the spike on grafana, latency up as well. 502s and some 504s.

sam_infra: just pulled logs from the model-runner fleet, getting repeated segfaults in model-runtime on node gpu-07: kernel trace attached.

anna_research: can you paste the stack sample? guessing KV cache corruption or quant kernel fault.

sam_infra: ````
[2024-03-12T14:53:21Z] model-runner[pid=2314]: segfault at 0x7f8c3f.. ip 0x55f3ab..
#0 0x55f3ab in attention_forward+0x120
#1 0x55d2b0 in forward_step+0x34
#2 0x55a0f0 in infer_dispatch+0x98
````

mike_oncall: noted. impact: customer-facing error rate 15-20% for a minority of requests (longer seq lengths). Lina, can you check open tickets?

lina_support: 4 customers reported timeouts in last 20m, two on Dedicated. Escalating with account teams.

anna_research: model version & quant profile? did we recently roll a quantized variant?

sam_infra: rolled q4_0 build to a subset earlier this morning (canary). Traffic split 10/90. Looks like canary nodes are failing under long-context jobs.

mike_oncall: immediate mitigation: remove canary variant from routing and drain affected nodes. Sam, can you run the routing override?

sam_infra: doing override now: ````
# force route away from q4_0-canary
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN' \ 
  https://controlplane/api/routing/override -d '{"model":"my-model","variant":"q4_0-canary","weight":0}'
````

sam_infra: override applied. initiating drain on gpu-07 and gpu-08. will shift traffic to stable quant and fp16 pools.

incident-bot: Routing change detected: model=my-model variant=q4_0-canary -> weight 0 by sam_infra (1714500145)

mike_oncall: good. check if 5xx drops. Anna, any quick fixes on runtime side or a soft-fallback to smaller context?

anna_research: adding an automatic context-length cap at the gateway is low-risk. will patch in prod config: max_seq=2048 for affected route.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: gateway-config patch by anna_research (sha: b7c9d).

anna_research: patch applied. traffic now capped.

sam_infra: drains completed for gpu-07/08. those nodes are quarantined for postmortem. routing to stable pool increased by 12%.

mike_oncall: metrics: 5xx down from 18% -> 3% in 4m, p99 latency improving. Good. Lina, update customers that we're mitigating and monitoring.

lina_support: sending status update to affected customers now. ETA for full recovery: monitoring for 30m to confirm.

anna_research: started capturing core dump artifacts from quarantined nodes and running a repro workload on staging with long context. will try to reproduce segfault locally.

sam_infra: saving node images & container logs to /artifacts/incidents/1714500000/ for triage.

mike_oncall: next steps: (1) full rollback of q4_0 canary to stable next release, (2) run memory/attention-safety tests, (3) postmortem if root cause is kernel/quant interaction.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged by mike_oncall, severity=P2, bridge=open.

lina_support: posted customer note: "We identified elevated 5xxs affecting inference for long inputs. We have rerouted traffic and applied a temporary context cap. Monitoring continues."

mike_oncall: thanks everyone. staying on the thread for 30m. escalate to SRE lead if errors re-spike. :thumbsup:
